raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
This PR is for model enabling, and may not be the most performant way
To successfully run kimi, we also rely on a MLA fix(https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63530)

Kimi-Linear currently falls through to the NVIDIA implementation on XPU. It fails while importing the CUDA-only CUTLASS GEMM code; disabling that path still leaves calls to fused MLA ops that are not available on XPU.

Use the existing implementation in `amd.linear` for Kimi-Linear on XPU. Despite the directory name, its portable KDA/MLA path runs on XPU. This reuses existing code rather than adding a separate XPU implementation. Kimi-K3 and MTP keep their current routes. Update the existing ReplaySSM expectation to match the selected implementation.

detail.body:
This PR is for model enabling, and may not be the most performant way
To successfully run kimi, we also rely on a MLA fix(https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63530)

Kimi-Linear currently falls through to the NVIDIA implementation on XPU. It fails while importing the CUDA-only CUTLASS GEMM code; disabling that path still leaves calls to fused MLA ops that are not available on XPU.

Use the existing implementation in `amd.linear` for Kimi-Linear on XPU. Despite the directory name, its portable KDA/MLA path runs on XPU. This reuses existing code rather than adding a separate XPU implementation. Kimi-K3 and MTP keep their current routes. Update the existing ReplaySSM expectation to match the selected implementation.
detail.title: [XPU] Fix Kimi-Linear model dispatch

files.patch:
@@ -170,7 +170,10 @@ def test_registry_inspect_does_not_init_cuda(model_arch):
     [
         # ReplaySSM is opt-in per model.
         ("NemotronHForCausalLM", True),
-        ("KimiLinearForCausalLM", not current_platform.is_rocm()),
+        (
+            "KimiLinearForCausalLM",
+            not (current_platform.is_rocm() or current_platform.is_xpu()),
+        ),
         ("KimiK3ForConditionalGeneration", not current_platform.is_rocm()),
         ("Mamba2ForCausalLM", False),
         ("Zamba2ForCausalLM", False),

@@ -5,6 +5,9 @@
 The implementation lives under ``nvidia/`` and ``amd/``; this module picks the
 right one for the current platform and re-exports the public classes used by
 the model registry. (Mirrors ``vllm.models.minimax_m3``.)
+
+On XPU, Kimi-Linear uses the reference KDA/MLA path in ``amd/linear.py``
+instead of the NVIDIA-specific fused attention kernels.
 """
 
 from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
@@ -24,6 +27,10 @@
     from .amd.linear import KimiLinearForCausalLM  # type: ignore[assignment]
     from .amd.model import KimiK3ForConditionalGeneration  # type: ignore[assignment]
     from .amd.mtp import KimiK3MTP  # type: ignore[assignment]
+elif current_platform.is_xpu():
+    from .amd.linear import KimiLinearForCausalLM  # type: ignore[assignment]
+    from .nvidia.model import KimiK3ForConditionalGeneration
+    from .nvidia.mtp import KimiK3MTP
 else:
     from .nvidia.model import KimiK3ForConditionalGeneration, KimiLinearForCausalLM
     from .nvidia.mtp import KimiK3MTP
